title: Design System: Dr. Mario Portillo — Cirujano Ortopedista

display.purpose: The hero headline only, now set in white against the navy gradient.

title.purpose: Card and profile titles — doctor name, service names, body-part names, credential entries.

shadows.name: card-active
shadows.purpose: State signal on the active body-part accordion card; not a resting elevation.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: The confirmed elevation exception, applied only to the doctor-profile card and the contact-grid card.

shadows.name: glow-turquoise
shadows.purpose: Colored glow shadow on every turquoise-fill button (Colored-Glow Rule), intensifies on hover.

shadows.name: glow-navy
shadows.purpose: Colored glow shadow on every navy-fill button.

shadows.name: floating-contact
shadows.purpose: Turquoise-tinted shadow for the fixed floating contact button, matching its own fill color.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Strong ease-out curve used for hover lifts, the floating contact button, the mobile nav dropdown, and hotspot/accordion transitions.

motion.name: interaction-fast
motion.purpose: Button/link background-color and card border-color hover transitions.

motion.name: interaction-reveal
motion.purpose: Accordion grid-row reveal and anatomy-diagram hotspot radius transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The site's one true call-to-action style — vivid turquoise fill, white text, pill-shaped, with a turquoise-tinted glow shadow. Lifts on hover and presses on click.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0.8rem 1.75rem; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:0.95rem; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; background-color:#0F766E; color:#FFFFFF; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(15,118,110,0.35); transition:background-color 0.2s ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color:#0B5D57; box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(15,118,110,0.45); } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0B3D91; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Deep navy fill, white text, pill-shaped with a navy-tinted glow shadow — used for the always-visible header CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0.8rem 1.75rem; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:0.95rem; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; background-color:#0B3D91; color:#FFFFFF; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(11,61,145,0.35); transition:background-color 0.2s ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color:#072659; box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(11,61,145,0.45); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0F766E; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button, Light
components.description: Transparent, white-bordered pill button for use only on the navy-gradient sections (e.g., the hero's second CTA). Never use the dark-surface Ghost variant here — its navy border disappears on a navy background.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-light { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0.8rem 1.75rem; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:0.95rem; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6); cursor:pointer; background-color:transparent; color:#FFFFFF; transition:background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost-light:hover { background-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-color:#FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-ghost-light:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Flat, bordered card with an icon tile — the system's default content card. Icon tile background is now a navy tint.
components.html:
Ortopedia General

Diagnóstico integral de padecimientos óseos y articulares, manejo de fracturas y dolor articular agudo.
components.css: .ds-card { background-color:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #D3E6E3; border-radius:4px; padding:2rem 1.5rem; transition:border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color:#0B3D91; } .ds-card-icon { width:48px; height:48px; background-color:rgba(11,61,145,0.08); color:#0B3D91; border-radius:4px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:1.25rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif; font-weight:600; font-size:1.2rem; color:#072659; margin-bottom:0.75rem; } .ds-card-desc { color:#52626C; font-size:0.9rem; line-height:1.5; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Bordered input with a resting Mist Background fill that turns white on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.4rem; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:500; color:#1E2A33; } .ds-input { width:100%; padding:0.75rem; border:1px solid #D3E6E3; border-radius:4px; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; color:#1E2A33; background-color:#F0FAF9; outline:none; transition:border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#0B3D91; background-color:#FFFFFF; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Sticky header nav links — color-only hover/active state.
components.html: Dónde te dueleAtenciónContacto
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2rem; } .ds-nav-link { font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:400; color:#1E2A33; text-decoration:none; transition:color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link--active { color:#0B3D91; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0B3D91; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Anatomy Hotspot
components.description: Signature interactive marker overlaid on the real skeleton photograph by percentage position — a turquoise ring-and-dot that turns navy on hover/active, synchronized with the body-part list at left. Also keyboard-operable (tabindex, role=button, Enter/Space). Div-based (not SVG) so it positions independently of the photo's own coordinate space.
components.css: .ds-hotspot { position:absolute; width:28px; height:28px; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); cursor:pointer; } .ds-hotspot-ring { position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:50%; background-color:#0F766E; opacity:0.25; transition:opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-hotspot-dot { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; width:10px; height:10px; margin:-5px 0 0 -5px; border-radius:50%; background-color:#0F766E; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF; transition:background-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-hotspot:hover .ds-hotspot-ring, .ds-hotspot.active .ds-hotspot-ring { opacity:0.5; transform:scale(1.3); } .ds-hotspot:hover .ds-hotspot-dot, .ds-hotspot.active .ds-hotspot-dot { background-color:#0B3D91; } .ds-hotspot:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0B3D91; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Floating Contact Button
components.description: Fixed bottom-right pill CTA, vivid turquoise with white text and a turquoise-tinted glow shadow. Hidden until the visitor scrolls past ~60% of the hero, then fades and slides in. Click scrolls to the contact section and focuses the name field.
components.html: Contáctanos
components.css: .ds-floating-contact { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.6rem; padding:0.85rem 1.4rem; background-color:#0F766E; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:0.92rem; white-space:nowrap; border-radius:9999px; box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(15,118,110,0.45); text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 0.2s ease, transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-floating-contact:hover { background-color:#0B5D57; } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-floating-contact:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); } } .ds-floating-contact:active { transform:scale(0.96); } .ds-floating-contact:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Virtual Assistant Toggle + Bubble
components.description: Bottom-left circular toggle (mirrors the floating contact button at bottom-right) opening a predefined Q&A chat panel navigated as a directed graph, not a generative AI chat. Bot messages are bordered Paper White bubbles; user-choice echoes are filled Deep Navy. Panel uses --radius-md (12px) with shadow only, no border (see Elevation's gpt-thin-border-wide-shadow note).
components.html:
El dolor de rodilla puede deberse a...
Dolor de rodilla
components.css: .ds-chat-bubble { max-width:85%; padding:0.65rem 0.9rem; border-radius:12px; font-size:0.88rem; line-height:1.5; } .ds-chat-bubble--bot { background-color:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #D3E6E3; color:#1E2A33; border-bottom-left-radius:2px; } .ds-chat-bubble--user { background-color:#0B3D91; color:#FFFFFF; border-bottom-right-radius:2px; margin-left:auto; }

components.name: Stats Banner
components.description: Full-bleed navy-gradient strip beneath the hero showing four figures (years, surgeries, patients, association count). Numbers set in Turquoise Light — never full-strength Turquoise or Ink, both fail contrast on the navy gradient.
components.html:
+15
Años de Experiencia
components.css: .ds-stats { background:linear-gradient(135deg, #072659 0%, #0B3D91 100%); padding:3rem 1.5rem; display:flex; gap:2rem; } .ds-stat { text-align:center; } .ds-stat-number { font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif; font-size:2.75rem; font-weight:700; color:#5EEAD4; line-height:1; margin-bottom:0.5rem; } .ds-stat-label { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:500; }

components.name: Association Badge
components.description: Text badge for a confirmed professional-association membership (reuses the Trust Pill pattern). Never a recreated logo — see PRODUCT.md.
components.html: American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS)
components.css: .ds-assoc-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.4rem; background-color:rgba(15,118,110,0.1); color:#072659; border:1px solid rgba(15,118,110,0.3); padding:0.4rem 1rem; border-radius:9999px; font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:500; }

narrative.overview:
This is a private orthopedic practice's site, not a hospital brochure and not a SaaS landing page — the two looks it explicitly rejects. The system was recolored end to end on the client's explicit request: the original steady-blue-plus-gold palette read as too quiet against a page with few real photographs, and the client wanted a color identity bold enough to carry the page on its own. Vivid Turquoise now does the work Burnished Gold used to do (the one true action color), and a saturated Deep Navy replaces the old muted slate blue as the grounding professional tone — turquoise keeps the register health/wellness-positive, navy keeps it a serious surgical practice.

Ordinary cards still use hairline borders, not shadow. What's new: three sections (hero, stats banner, contact) carry a full navy-gradient background as deliberate rhythm-setting color blocks; buttons are pill-shaped with a glow shadow tinted to their own fill color (the client's explicit "make it stand out" request); and the page's neutral background is a soft turquoise-tinted off-white instead of plain gray.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, bordered surfaces for ordinary cards; three intentional full-navy-gradient sections (hero, stats banner, contact) carry the boldest color moments.
One saturated accent (Vivid Turquoise) for every call to action, plus a light variant reserved strictly for text on the navy sections.
Every button is pill-shaped with a glow shadow tinted to its own fill color.
Editorial serif display type (Fraunces) paired with a clean, technical sans body (IBM Plex Sans) — unchanged from the original brief.
A soft turquoise-tinted off-white replaces the old neutral gray as the page's resting background.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Vivid Turquoise appears only on things the visitor can act on or should notice first (primary CTA, floating contact button, hotspots, timeline markers, trust pills). It never fills a large surface or appears on more than one element per view without a specific reason.

rules.name: The Light-on-Navy Rule
rules.body: Any text or icon set directly on one of the three navy-gradient sections uses white or Turquoise Light — never Ink, never full-strength Vivid Turquoise or Deep Navy text on a navy background.

rules.name: The Pill-Button Rule
rules.body: Every button-shaped interactive element is fully rounded (--radius-pill). A 4px-radius button next to a pill-radius button reads as an inconsistency, not a hierarchy.

rules.name: The Colored-Glow Rule
rules.body: Every solid-fill button carries a box-shadow tinted to its own fill color, not a neutral gray shadow — the client's explicit request to make buttons stand out.

rules.name: The Three Dark Sections Rule
rules.body: Exactly three sections carry the full navy gradient: hero, stats banner, contact. Don't add a fourth without a specific reason — the effect works because it's rare and purposeful.

rules.name: The Serif-Names-Sans-Explains Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is reserved for anything acting as a name or title. IBM Plex Sans carries everything the visitor reads for information. Unchanged by the recolor.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Ordinary cards reach for a 1px hairline border before a shadow. Unchanged by the recolor.

dos: Do keep Vivid Turquoise rare — one primary action or emphasis point per view (The One Accent Rule).
Do use white or Turquoise Light for anything set directly on a navy-gradient section (The Light-on-Navy Rule).
Do make every new button pill-shaped with a glow shadow tinted to its own fill (The Pill-Button Rule, The Colored-Glow Rule).
Do use Fraunces only for names/titles and IBM Plex Sans for everything read for information.
Do default ordinary cards to hairline borders before adding shadow (The Border-First Rule).
Do keep the anatomy diagram's list-and-hotspot sync intact when touching that section.
donts: Don't let the page read as a generic corporate hospital brochure or a generic tech-startup landing page.
Don't introduce a third saturated accent color; Deep Navy and Vivid Turquoise (plus its light, text-only variant) are the complete palette.
Don't add a fourth full-navy-gradient section without a specific reason (The Three Dark Sections Rule).
Don't apply the doctor-profile/contact-grid shadow exception to ordinary cards (service, step, testimonial) — they stay flat.
Don't invent real contact details, credentials, or testimonials, and don't invent new statistics beyond the three explicit placeholders already recorded.
Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above a section heading.

Don't set white or Ink text on Vivid Turquoise interchangeably without checking contrast — Ink fails (~2.7:1), white passes (~5.5:1). Never set full-strength Turquoise as text on a navy background — use Turquoise Light.
Don't hand-draw or approximate a third-party organization's logo — confirmed associations render as text badges until real logo files are supplied.
